def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==5]
    for i,(r1,c1) in enumerate(pts):
        for r2,c2 in pts[i+1:]:
            dr=r2-r1; dc=c2-c1
            if dr==0 or dc==0 or abs(dr)==abs(dc):
                n=max(abs(dr),abs(dc))
                sr=0 if dr==0 else (1 if dr>0 else -1)
                sc=0 if dc==0 else (1 if dc>0 else -1)
                for k in range(1,n): out[r1+sr*k][c1+sc*k]=3
    return out
